title: PowerScope rolling error & interval failure
protocol: Read-only reanalysis of frozen chronological and drift forecasts; daily288-point blocks, residual coverage vs width; no recalibration on test or model retraining. Counterfactual contributions from frozen linear weights.
findings: Interval width / coverage trade-off is descriptive and not a certified protection margin.
Chronological residual dependence prevents independent-example binomial guarantees.
Drift cannot be fixed by silently widening an interval; bias, MAE and tail error stay visible.
scope: AI-assisted new local stress experiments; no retraining, external API, private data or production claim
